name: Update Activity Types
purpose: One-time migration: inside a transaction, upserts the ActivityType lookup rows from an embedded JSON list (1 Email, 2 Note, 3 Task, 4 Event, 5 Comment, 6 Meeting, 7 Letter, 8 Call, 9 SMS, 10 Discussion) and sets the next serial value of ActivityType::Id. Its effect (seeding the ActivityType lookup) would belong to server-domain as seed data. One-time migration from the 2018-11-13 _OTTO_ folder ('Completed Migration Scripts').
writes:
DBTransactions::ActivityTypeId#81 (step 79, current record)
ActivityType::ONE#22 (step 81, related via ActivityType (creates or locks record))
ActivityType::Description#12 (step 85, record created in step 81)
serial: ActivityType::Id#18 next serial value (Set Next Serial Value step 90)
open_question: The ActivityType ids 1-10 are used as constants by other scripts (for example type 1 email, 2 note, 3 task, 10 discussion), so the seed data must be carried into the target. $NextSerial is not initialised before the first comparison (step 77). Only caller is the _Otto_2018-11-13 wrapper (in the Scripts menu).

name: Cache Party Name on Opportunities
purpose: One-time migration: on layout f_Opportunity it takes the ids of all opportunities and, one by one inside a transaction, copies the related party's cached name into Opportunity::PartyNameCached. Its effect (filling a cached name) is what the cached field would receive in the target. One-time migration from the 2018-11-13 _OTTO_ folder ('Completed Migration Scripts').
writes:
DBTransactions::OpportunityId#60 (step 73, current record)
DBTransactions::PartyId#25 (step 74, current record)
Opportunity::PartyNameCached#64 (step 76, related via Opportunity (record chosen by DBTransactions::OpportunityId))
open_question: Show All Records at step 35 sets the scope to every opportunity. The loop runs from 0 to ValueCount inclusive (steps 64-69), so it makes one extra pass with an empty id. $ActivityIds in the result (step 84) is never set. Only caller is the _Otto_2018-11-13 wrapper (in the Scripts menu).
